name: linux-pinyin-search
title: Port Linux pinyin search and East Asian naming behavior
description: Port pinyin-assisted search/name behavior to Linux while reusing cpp-pinyin and portable localization logic.
creator: charl
notes: Canonical Process adapter integrated with shared cpp-pinyin dictionary; lazy initialization and escape-preserving normalization. Actual ELF Chinese/full-pinyin/initials/uppercase/mixed queries pass; user confirmed pinyin search. East Asian naming hooks remain unported.
